description:
Though his family is packed with famous celebrities, Izumi Sena is just your average guy. Currently a college student, he's a huge otaku with aspirations of becoming a manga creator. But one day he gets roped into filming a TV commercial and meets hot young actor Ryoma Ichijo. Not only does Ryoma remember Sena from a commercial they were in together as children, but he’s also been carrying a torch all these years for the girl he thinks starred opposite him! What will he do when he finds out she is really a he?

(Source: SuBLime Manga)

node.description: Sena Izumi is an 18-year-old boy who just entered college. He is a major otaku, and is obsessed with Magical Girl LalaLulu.   Izumi is very skinny, and extremely short for his age - making it easy to believe he is a girl. In fact, he meets love interest Ryouma while playing a bride to him in a television commercial.   Izumi dislikes show business and, despite his family urging him to try acting, he ambitions to become a popular mangaka like Saotome Miyabi.

Height: 180 cm (5"9)  Ryouma is a young actor who, after much hardship, has become quite popular with the fans and media. He envies Izumi's brother, Shougo, for his superior fan base.  Ryouma is big headed and brash. Like Shougo, he has a friendly and outgoing nature, complimented by good looks. He is very ambitious.   Previously believed to be heterosexual, his feelings for Izumi confuse Ryouma greatly, and even cause him to become enraged and lash out Izumi in the beginning. Ryouma definitely struggles with his sexuality throughout the manga.

Rei is the manager of the famous Sena family. He is serious with a no-nonsense personality. He is a hard worker and is the main care-taker of Izumi, seeing him as his own son. Rei is somewhat of a Deadpan Snarker, wearing a constant poker face and bluntly telling it how it is. He sugar coats nothing. His cool and professional exterior can sometimes make people think he doesn't care.   He is surprisingly tolerant of Shougo, despite his easy-to-annoy nature.

__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

Lead vocalist of the super-popular rock band Crusherz. Writes lyrics under the name "Shogo."  Multi-talented, he tried a lot of different things before settling in with the band. Really loves his little brother.

She is the mother of [Shougo](https://anilist.co/character/51463/Sena-Shougo) and [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/51935/Sena-Izumi), and is older than Seiya. She is a model turned actress and a bit of a spoiled princess.

He is the father of Shougo and Izumi. He is a stage actor with a focus in musical theatre. He was scouted by his own mother and debuted as a singer. He produces shows and is the founder of SenaPro, the Sena family's personal agency.
